title: Your Mortgage Refi Might Lose You $18,000
hook: You refinanced to cut your payment — but if you move before the break-even point, you've just handed the bank $18,000 for nothing.
angle: The break-even trap in mortgage refinancing — most homeowners never calculate it, and 52% move before they ever recoup closing costs.
audience: Homeowners aged 30-55 who have refinanced or are considering it, and anyone who bought the 'lower your payment' pitch without doing the full math.
key_numbers: $6,000: average closing costs on a standard refinance
52%: homeowners who move within 5 years of refinancing
$18,000: total loss when you refi twice and sell before break-even
0.5%: minimum rate drop most experts say justifies refi costs
